annotations.title: Get the Moon's phase and the lunation's exact times

description:
Returns the Moon's phase at an instant: phase angle, illuminated fraction, the eight-fold name, waxing or waning, age in days, tropical sign and degree, distance, and the four principal phases of that lunation to the second in UTC; optionally every principal phase across a date range.

A count of days from one new moon in steps of 29.53 follows the mean month, and a real new moon can fall more than half a day from the mean one; the gap is widest at the quarters and the full moon. Phase names follow Moon-Sun elongation. The phase changes within a day, so the hour matters; "time" is UTC and defaults to 00:00.

Results include an attribution line and a permalink.

date.description: The date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, 1700-2200. Example: "2026-09-20". Defaults to today (UTC).

time.description: Time of day HH:MM, read as UTC. Example: "12:00". Defaults to 00:00 UTC.

to.description: End of a range, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, up to 400 days after date. Example: "2026-12-31". Lists every principal phase between.

name: compute_moon_phase
